title: Audience in tiered seating facing presenter in a glass-walled innovation space
objects_and_counts: At least 19 people are visible in the photographed scene; many are seated on tiered steps at left and on cube seats in the centre; a precise exact count is uncertain because some people are partially obscured behind others.
One person is standing at right facing the audience and appears to be speaking; this person is wearing a mask.
There is one tripod-mounted camera or video camera centrally placed on the floor in front of the seated audience.

There are multiple cube seats/stools arranged across the centre of the room: I count 11 distinct cube seats/stools visible in the foreground and midground (a row of 6 blue/teal/grey cubes in the centre-right and additional cubes/stools on the far left and near front).
Two black chairs with armrests are visible at far right beside a small round side table.
One small round side table with a white top holds a small potted plant, two white cups and a dark object (possibly a remote or small device).
A stepped tiered seating structure at left holds many seated people; the tiers have blue horizontal surfaces and white vertical faces.
At least two laptops are visible: one laptop on the lap of a person seated on the tiered steps and another laptop visible on a person's lap near the glass doors.
Two glass doors or large glass panels form the back/right wall of the space; each has small printed signs and a vertical handle area.
Large printed wall signage and wall graphics are present on the left wall above the tiered seating (see visible_text for exact transcriptions).
spatial_relations: Tiered seating is at the left side of the image; audience members sit on these steps and face toward the right where the presenter stands.
A row of cube seats/stools forms a central block between the tiered seating at left and the presenter area at right.
The presenter stands at the right edge of the open floor area, near the glass-walled back and right side of the room.
The tripod-mounted camera is positioned on the floor in front of the seated audience, roughly in the centre foreground, between the audience and the presenter.
Two black armchairs and a small round table are located to the right of the cube seating near the presenter, forming a small presenter area.
Glass doors/panels form the back/right boundary of the space; wall signage reading 'Innovation academy' is visible on or behind the glass near the centre-right background.
colours_and_materials: Cube seats/stools are mainly blue with some teal and grey cubes visible; the tiered seating surfaces are blue with white risers.
Flooring is a light grey carpet with a narrow linear pattern.
Back and right walls are glass panels; metal door handles are visible on the glass.
The small round side table has a white tabletop and yellow legs (legs appear yellow or light wood), and the two presenter chairs are black with plastic or vinyl surfaces.
A small potted plant on the table has green leaves in a dark pot.
uncertainties: The exact number of people is uncertain because some attendees are partly obscured behind others on the tiered seating; the quoted minimum of 19 is a conservative visible count.

Several small printed signs on the glass doors are partly legible; one sign clearly shows 'PUSH' while others are only partially readable and have been transcribed as 'Reserved for [unreadable]' and '[unreadable]'.

The exact printed capitalization and punctuation of the wall signage reads as 'INNOVATION' in large letters and 'Innovation academy' on glass; it is unclear whether these are official room names or branded signage for the space.
Some smaller labels or stickers on the glass and walls are too small or blurred to transcribe precisely.
The dark object on the round table is not clearly identifiable from the image; described only as 'dark object (possibly a remote or small device)'.
